name: betterplan-skills
description: Official skill registry for Betterplan — planning & delivery method.

skills.name: betterplan-workflow
skills.description: Classifies work into the correct Betterplan building block and holds shared conventions for all create-* skills.

skills.name: betterplan-create-initiative
skills.description: Creates or phrases a Betterplan Initiative — a large goal that sets direction.

skills.name: betterplan-create-epic
skills.description: Creates a Betterplan Epic — a sub-goal under an Initiative that represents a step toward the goal.

skills.name: betterplan-create-story
skills.description: Creates a Betterplan Story (user, project, or devteam story).

skills.name: betterplan-create-workitem
skills.description: Breaks a Betterplan Story into Workitems or reports bugs as Workitems.
